story_context: SlackからBrainbaseまでのmulti-tenant E2Eで、tenant_id、workspace connection、credential、runtime state、usage Receiptをcross-tenant混線なく扱う。Cloudとcompatible OSSの共通契約を固定する。

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Canonical snake_case envelope defined by common_contract.tenant_context_envelope; Brainbase issues a detached JWS using EdDSA/Ed25519 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, excluding integrity; maximum TTL is 300 seconds with 30 seconds clock skew.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Replace schema_version/protocol_version draft variants with the canonical envelope, publish current and retiring verification keys, and issue immutable envelopes.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Replace the camelCase version:1 draft envelope, verify JWS/time/audience at every boundary, and never extend or mutate an envelope.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: New shared identifiers use a lowercase type prefix plus uppercase Crockford ULID; provider IDs and existing Brainbase entity IDs remain opaque canonical strings and are never inferred or rewritten.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Add op_<ULID> and the shared opaque-ID constraints to the ID table.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Adopt the prefixed ULID formats for generated IDs and preserve Slack/Brainbase opaque IDs byte-for-byte.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Resolve at ingress, invalidate projections from ordered events, and perform an authoritative expected-revision read immediately before credential lease, Brainbase write, and Slack delivery; cache TTL is at most 30 seconds and cache alone never authorizes an irreversible effect.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Expose authoritative conditional revision validation and monotonic revision events; event delivery is an optimization, not authority.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Add the four recheck points and fail closed on stale, revoked, unavailable, or mismatched connection state.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Protocol ID is mana-brainbase-tenant-context, current version is 1.0, supported range is >=1.0 <2.0, peers negotiate the highest mutually supported minor, and unsupported required capabilities or major versions fail without downgrade; deprecation notice is at least 90 days.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Return selected_version, supported_range, required/optional capabilities, and compatibility_until in negotiation.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Implement same-major negotiation and explicit PROTOCOL_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED/PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED failures.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Brainbase is the sole credential and refresh-state owner. mana-runtime carries only an opaque credential_ref and requests a single-use, operation/audience-bound lease of at most 60 seconds; raw material may exist only in trusted volatile injection memory and never in queues, Durable Objects, model/tool payloads, disk, logs, fixtures, or Receipts.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Own OAuth refresh CAS/audit and implement broker lease/proxy issuance bound to tenant, connection revision, operation, audience, and mode.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Remove canonical OAuth refresh ownership, consume only scoped leases through a trusted injector, scrub after use, and prohibit alternate-mode fallback.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Brainbase owns contract/quota and canonical UsageEvent/OperationReceipt/business-effect ledger; mana-runtime owns queue and Slack-delivery claims. Quota values are revisioned contract data, usage collection_state is separate from outcome, idempotency keys use the fixed length-prefixed formula, and ledgers retain terminal claims for at least 30 days.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Adopt fixed quota/usage/Receipt enums and schemas, persist business/Receipt claims, and reject payload/context hash conflicts.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Adopt the same operation IDs and key derivation, split Brainbase-write and Slack-delivery claims, and report observed usage without inventing zero.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: collection_state is collected|partial|not_collected; outcome is succeeded|failed|cancelled|timed_out; unavailable/timeout are failure observations, and a collected empty result is NO_DATA with observed_units=0 rather than not_collected.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Map measured to collected and unavailable to not_collected plus an explicit failure code.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Remove not_measured from outcome and emit collection_state independently.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Protocol v1 forbids cross-tenant Container reuse. Same-tenant reuse requires a complete sanitization receipt; any failed or unobservable check destroys the Container, and persistent model/Claude sessions never cross operation leases.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: No execution-plane implementation; consume sanitization status only as Receipt evidence when present.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Tighten the draft from conditional cross-tenant reuse to tenant-change-always-destroy and implement the fixed receipt checks.

cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Only explicitly optional advertised capabilities may be non_applicable with a reason. Tenant context, signature/time validation, revision checks, authorization, credential scope, isolation, idempotency, failure semantics, Usage/Receipt, and no-fallback are mandatory in Cloud and compatible OSS.
cross_lane_decision_table.brainbase_follow_up: Use customer_managed_oss as the wire profile and mark only listed optional capabilities unsupported/non_applicable.
cross_lane_decision_table.mana_runtime_follow_up: Map shared/dedicated/customer_hosted to shared_cloud/dedicated_cloud/customer_managed_oss and do not relax common controls.

protocol.request_response_rule: request and response both carry supported_range, enumerated supported_versions, and required_capabilities; response also carries selected_version, optional capability statuses, and compatibility_until

canonical_tenant_owner.rule: Slack workspace、channel、project、credential、runtime placementからtenant_idを推論してはならない。

workspace_connection.revision_type: canonical unsigned decimal string matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ and monotonically increasing per connection_id
workspace_connection.revision_rule: 受付時に解決し、credential lease、Brainbase write、Slack deliveryの各不可逆副作用直前にBrainbaseへexpected connection_revisionを指定したauthoritative readを行う。stale、revoked、unavailable、workspace/app不一致はfail closedとし、cacheまたはrevision eventだけで不可逆副作用を許可しない。
workspace_connection.event_rule: Revision events are monotonic cache-invalidation hints; missed or reordered events are recovered by authoritative reads and never authorize an effect.

signature.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme over the envelope with integrity omitted
signature.serialization: RFC 7797 unencoded payload detached compact JWS; signing input is ASCII(base64url(JCS protected header) + '.') followed by raw UTF-8 JCS(unsigned envelope), serialized as protected64..signature64
signature.key_rotation: Validators accept current and explicitly retiring public keys only; a retiring key remains published until every envelope it signed has expired.

time_validity.refresh: forbidden; obtain a newly resolved and newly signed envelope

authorization.actor_source: Brainbase canonical principal resolved from authenticated Slack workspace and subject binding
authorization.project_rule: requested project_ids must be a subset of Brainbase-authorized projects for tenant.tenant_id and actor.principal_id
authorization.capability_rule: requested capability_ids must be a subset of the selected placement and connection contract

correlation_and_idempotency.correlation_rule: One correlation_id is created for one accepted Slack event and is preserved unchanged through reply Receipt.
correlation_and_idempotency.operation_rule: Each logical side effect has one stable operation_id. Brainbase write and Slack delivery use distinct operation_id values under the same correlation_id.
correlation_and_idempotency.length_prefix_encoding: LP(v) = uint32be(UTF-8 byte length of v) followed by UTF-8 bytes of v
correlation_and_idempotency.idempotency_derivation: ik1_ + base64url_without_padding(SHA-256(LP(protocol_id) || LP(protocol_major) || LP(tenant_id) || LP(connection_id) || LP(slack_event_id) || LP(operation_id)))
correlation_and_idempotency.retry_rule: A retry reuses the same idempotency_key across connection revision refresh. Before an effect is claimed, a refreshed signed context may replace a stale one; after claim, any context_hash or payload_hash change fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

ledger_owners.brainbase: credential lease, quota decision, canonical business write, UsageEvent, OperationReceipt

correlation_and_idempotency.side_effect_limit: At most one accepted effect per operation_id; Brainbase write and Slack reply are independently claimed and independently receipted.

credential_modes.lookup_key: tenant_id + connection_id + connection_revision + contract_revision + operation_id + audience + credential_mode + credential_ref
credential_modes.transport: opaque credential_ref in envelope; single-use broker lease or proxy handle at execution
credential_modes.trusted_injection_rule: If a provider requires direct credential material, only a trusted injector may materialize it in isolated volatile process memory; it is scrubbed immediately after the call and is never exposed to an untrusted model or tool payload.
credential_modes.billing_rule: billing principal and usage attribution follow the Brainbase workspace connection revision; unavailable or missing attribution is not zero.

quota.threshold_values: revisioned tenant contract data; no cross-contract default
quota.check_rule: Check the current contract_revision before any billable effect and record the decision even when unavailable or denied.

usage_and_receipt.empty_rule: A successfully collected empty result is outcome=succeeded, collection_state=collected, observed_units=0, failure_code=NO_DATA.
usage_and_receipt.failure_accounting: Record observed usage on failures; missing, unavailable, partial, or timeout must use collection_state and must not be represented as zero or success.
usage_and_receipt.receipt_retention: OperationReceipt is immutable after finalization and retained under the tenant contract for at least the 30-day terminal idempotency window.
usage_and_receipt.secret_policy: No raw credential, token, authorization header, or secret value is recorded.

container_sanitization.same_tenant_reuse: allowed only within an unexpired operation lease after every required check passes
container_sanitization.persistent_model_session_rule: A persistent model or Claude session never crosses operation leases.

optional_non_applicable_conditions.condition: customer_managed_oss does not advertise Cloud billing export
customer_managed_oss is operated by the customer

optional_non_applicable_conditions.required_evidence: deployment profile and isolation reason; all other tenant controls remain required
credential mode capability advertisement; no fallback

optional_non_applicable_conditions.condition: the tested contract has no customer-specific pricing
optional_non_applicable_conditions.required_evidence: fixture reason; quota and Receipt schema tests remain required

deployment_compatibility.optional_capability_rule: A capability is non_applicable only when listed above, explicitly advertised as optional/unsupported, and accompanied by a reason. Single-tenant OSS does not waive tenant context or isolation.
deployment_compatibility.version_rule: Cloud and compatible OSS negotiate >=1.0 <2.0 or fail with PROTOCOL_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED/PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED; silent downgrade is forbidden.

tenant_identity.resolution_point: Brainbase canonical workspace connection resolution before any business API call

resources.name: tenant_context_envelope
resources.residue_policy: retention excludes secrets; envelope expires within 300 seconds and is never refreshed in place

resources.name: queue_and_durable_runtime_state
resources.residue_policy: expire after terminal Receipt retention period

resources.name: tool_container_or_sandbox
resources.residue_policy: destroy on tenant change; same-tenant reuse requires a complete sanitization Receipt, otherwise destroy

resources.name: credential_connection
resources.residue_policy: raw secret is never persisted in mana artifacts; one-use lease expires within 60 seconds

resources.name: usage_and_operation_receipt
resources.residue_policy: customer retention policy without raw secrets

credentials.broker_lookup_scope: tenant_id + connection_id + connection_revision + operation_id + audience + mode

data.residency: Declared by the Brainbase workspace connection and preserved by each deployment adapter
data.migration: Revisioned connection migration; old and new revisions cannot be active for the same operation
data.rollback: Revoke the new revision and resume only from an explicitly active prior revision; never infer or silently fall back

verification.note: Draft Spec defines required scanners and fixtures; implementation, Graph, and negative-run evidence has not been collected.

brainbase: Own canonical tenant_id and workspace connection identity/revision/status.
Resolve authenticated actor principal_id and authorize organization_ids, project_ids, data_scopes, and capability_ids.
Issue and sign the immutable TenantContextEnvelope and publish current/retiring verification keys.
Expose authoritative expected-revision validation and monotonic revision invalidation events.
Own credential mode, credential_ref, OAuth refresh state, credential broker, billing contract, quota policy, and canonical Graph/task readback.
Persist canonical UsageEvent, OperationReceipt, and business-effect idempotency claims without raw secrets.
Return explicit deny, unavailable, empty, partial, and timeout semantics.
mana_runtime: Verify Slack authenticity and JWS/time/audience of the immutable TenantContextEnvelope at every runtime boundary.
Perform authoritative workspace connection revision checks before credential lease, Brainbase write, and Slack delivery.
Partition queue, durable state, container/sandbox, tools, credential leases, results, and reply delivery by tenant scope.
Destroy Containers on tenant change; require complete sanitization Receipt for same-tenant reuse.
Own queue/Slack-delivery idempotency claims and use shared operation IDs and key derivation for Brainbase effects.
Observe usage, report collection_state independently from outcome, and emit one reply outcome.
shared_contract: Maintain protocol 1.x negotiation, capability advertisement, and compatibility fixtures.
Use the same failure codes and Receipt schema in Cloud and compatible OSS.
Prohibit all implicit fallback paths and preserve not_collected as distinct from zero or success.
